name: Tatrang I
description: Tatrang I was a hot rock planet with no moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the red giant Tatrang. Tatrang I was lifeless and was considered commercially worthless.
